actor: Local Codex intake; not independent OpenCode verdict

observations.observation: Probe-before-poll does not prove child is alive during the probe; an already-exited child can be sampled post-exit and counted as duringSampleCount=1. CLI never persists/prints returned spawnCalled:false, so the proposed five-point runtime zero-spawn proof is not actually bound to retained evidence. Do not accept this ordering change as closure of NF-4.

Coordinator still prefers shutil.which(node), wrapper invokes PATH python3 and preserves ambient PYTHONPATH; child/observer HOME/TMPDIR/PATH remain ambient. Default Next/cwd point at original harness whose dependency link was nonprivate. Candidate staging plan is unperformed and actual bindings do not select a private staged root. A pinned path string is not a verified isolated executable/dependency binding.

observations.area: owned identity and guard load order
observations.observation: All five real cleanup call sites now pass parent/name/handle and capture results, but helper still checks executable substring without immutable observed start identity, and wait success ignores return-code classification. Guard static import executes before later hash validation; candidate guardPath can differ from imported guard. These need exact bounded identity/load-order disposition rather than a blanket all-findings-closed claim.

Parent-directory fsync was added but every exception is swallowed. Durability cannot be claimed on fsync denial/failure, and failure is not surfaced to evaluator. Independent review should judge actual guarantee and missing failure tests.

Sample count/default/error-field fixes improve source; observer_exit_code still accepts False or 0.0 and exit_code comparisons accept bool, while expected identity stays optional. Standalone launcher stdout exists now, but no independent exact command/exit/stderr metadata or retained version-read transcript in manifest. Owner PASS counts remain cited, not replayed.
